# flac / fuzzer_metadata

flac's own fuzz target `fuzzer_metadata` ([source](source/metadata.cc), unmodified), one of the targets OSS-Fuzz builds, over flac (xiph/flac at e94ff9f6).

Writes the input to a temp .flac, runs level-0 getters, a level-1 SimpleIterator command sequence and a level-2 Chain/Iterator command sequence (get/insert/set/delete/resize blocks, sort/merge padding, write); results discarded. FLAC__metadata_object_is_equal(x, x) is computed and ignored.

## How this program differs from what OSS-Fuzz runs
- Linked against flac at commit e94ff9f6 with 1 patch to the library (listed on the project page).
- In every build, getenv() returns NULL, getpid() returns 1 and mkstemp() uses a fixed name, so the program depends only on its input.
- A small driver reads the input file, calls the harness one to four times and prints each return value.

## What the harness checks
- Level-2 metadata iterator consistency: a block whose get_type() is VORBIS_COMMENT must dynamic_cast to VorbisComment; each existing comment entry must have a non-NULL entry pointer; a valid VorbisComment::Entry must have a non-NULL field ([lines 269-280](source/metadata.cc#L269-L280)): abort(); not confirmed in the binary.

## Builds
Static riscv64 Linux programs, compiled for RV64G and run as `<file> <input-file>`; `oft fetch flac` downloads the published ones and checks each against its SHA-256.

| build | file | bytes | sha256 |
|---|---|---:|---|
| plain | `fuzzer_metadata.plain` | 395,464 | `9f8cd6dbceba720fbf86837e68e3ebf62119308f6d5ed45eac57313b93b495d5` |
| ubsan | `fuzzer_metadata.ubsan` | 402,808 | `5b59de72669d1c99e84e63009a809f9a969fbf3510c34ceced4b9dee586669ea` |
| asan | `fuzzer_metadata.asan` | 1,062,840 | `0b6e2dd0e9a4a61b1ff87374a04de0e2ad97e40d4d3a7e0bd7a7e0085f259a5a` |
| asan-ubsan | `fuzzer_metadata.asan-ubsan` | 1,060,312 | `6401706ebd30612159e0d76f7473ba6ebd91c7ea1f83ee2be9338bd95364ce3d` |

Each build also links code that no sanitizer instruments, as its link recorded it. A statement about a sanitizer build covers that code only as uninstrumented code: ASan checks no load or store made inside it, and UBSan inserts no check there.

- plain: `clang_rt.crtbegin.o` (compiler-rt), `libclang_rt.builtins.a` (compiler-rt), `crt1.o` (the C library), `libc++.a` (the C++ runtime), `libc.a` (the C library), `libogg.a` (a library from the build image), `libunwind.a` (the C++ runtime)
- ubsan: `clang_rt.crtbegin.o` (compiler-rt), `libclang_rt.builtins.a` (compiler-rt), `crt1.o` (the C library), `libc++.a` (the C++ runtime), `libc.a` (the C library), `libogg.a` (a library from the build image), `libunwind.a` (the C++ runtime)
- asan: `clang_rt.crtbegin.o` (compiler-rt), `libclang_rt.asan.a` (the sanitizer runtime), `libclang_rt.builtins.a` (compiler-rt), `crt1.o` (the C library), `libc++.a` (the C++ runtime), `libc.a` (the C library), `libogg.a` (a library from the build image), `libunwind.a` (the C++ runtime)
- asan-ubsan: `clang_rt.crtbegin.o` (compiler-rt), `libclang_rt.asan.a` (the sanitizer runtime), `libclang_rt.builtins.a` (compiler-rt), `crt1.o` (the C library), `libc++.a` (the C++ runtime), `libc.a` (the C library), `libogg.a` (a library from the build image), `libunwind.a` (the C++ runtime)
